findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "paediatric_warning_sign_check" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: childhood_vaccination_schedule · Private data: child_growth_percentile, childhood_vaccination_schedule · Public sink: paediatric_guide_finder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: childhood_vaccination_schedule · Private data: child_growth_percentile, childhood_vaccination_schedule · Public sink: paediatric_guide_finder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
